name: Ozen-v1
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-base (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: MHA, encoder-decoder (cross-attention): 12 encoder layers and 4 decoder layers, width 512, 8 heads x 64. NOT the base config - the card states the base was given a Hebrew tokenizer, doubled in depth to 12 encoder layers, then cut to 4 decoder layers, chosen by measurement (2/3/4 layers scored 24.95/21.31/20.13% held-out WER).
notes: ADDED 2026-11-05. Hebrew ASR model distilled from ivrit.ai's Whisper large-v3-turbo Hebrew fine-tune, descending from openai/whisper-base. ARCHITECTURE IS NOT INHERITED: unlike most records in this catalog, config.json here differs from the base - 12 encoder layers (base 6), 4 decoder layers, width 512, and an 8,192-token Hebrew byte-level BPE replacing Whisper's 51,865-token multilingual vocabulary. The card states the base was given the Hebrew tokenizer, doubled in depth to 12 encoder layers, then cut to 4 decoder layers, the depth chosen by measurement (2/3/4 layers = 24.95/21.31/20.13% held-out WER). num_layers is the encoder depth per this catalog's Whisper convention; kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 4 decoder layers x 8 heads x 64 x 2 (K/V) x 2 bytes = 8,192. 60.74M params, i.e. SMALLER than the 73M model it descends from. Trained on 3,519 hours of ivrit-ai/audio-v2 teacher transcripts plus 356 hours of human transcription; weights from step 220,000 of 303,562. The eval harness reproduces the ivrit.ai Hebrew leaderboard and was validated on 40 of 40 published model-dataset pairs, which is unusually strong provenance for a card. CAVEAT: the comparison is against STOCK multilingual Whisper of the same size, which the card itself says 'does not work for Hebrew'; the meaningful ceiling is the teacher (ivrit.ai turbo: 5.5 / 6.1 / 8.10), which still beats this model on all three sets. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-10-07. Also ships ONNX and transformers.js builds; recorded from the bf16 weights.

benchmarks.name: WER % (ivrit-ai/eval-d1)
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Benchmark | Ozen-v1, 61M | whisper-small, 242M | whisper-base, 73M | ivrit.ai turbo, 809M |': row 'ivrit-ai/eval-d1' 8.59% vs row 'whisper-base, 73M' 48.32%. LOWER IS BETTER. Harness reproduces the ivrit.ai Hebrew leaderboard, validated on 40/40 published model-dataset pairs. The model it was distilled from (ivrit.ai turbo) scores 5.5.
